description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android app, implementing the main TV home screen with RecyclerViews for navigation and content rows. It includes setup for top navigation categories and content sections with mock data, structured to support D-pad focus and accessibility features, suitable for a TV interface.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment representing the Android TV home screen with focusable navigation and content sections.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Initializes view binding and inflates the fragment layout.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the top navigation bar and content rails after view creation.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Configures the horizontal RecyclerView for top categories with initial focus management.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Configures vertical RecyclerView for content rows with mock data, ensuring focus behavior for TV navigation.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up view binding to prevent memory leaks.
